items.title: Show HN: Synth Patch Hero
items.summary: I wanted to be more deliberate and systematic in how I approach working on synth patches. With the help of our friend Claude, I put together a game that runs through exercises that builds that muscle in a fun and approachable way where you learn as you build patches on a modular rack.I do not have a Eurorack, nor a strong desire to own one (yet); but I do have a bit of other physical gear. I wanted to see if the lessons would translate to boxes, where sound is also better than the browser.
